messages.subject: DIF  with multilevel IRT
parts:
Dear all
I have multilevel data set(student in school).I want to use multilevel IRT(MLGRM) to detect DIF.
how can I do it in R?
thank you

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: DIF with multilevel IRT
parts:
Are you certain you need multilevel IRT here? Can you describe your data/analysis intentions? DIF is by definition multilevel, but invoking random effects is only necessary when the number of clusters is relatively large.

Phil
